changes: No substantive changes. Added to notes: the era is uncertain (VS assumed), 'kāmeśvarasya sevakaḥ' most likely refers to the deity, and 'lalitā…tmena' may hide a kinship term.

date.as_written: śrīsaṃvat 1772 bhādre māsi site ( pakṣe ) pūrṇā ca kujavāsare

notes: The colophon gives the year only as 'śrīsaṃvat 1772' and names no era. The record assumes Vikrama Saṃvat (VS 1772 ≈ 1715 CE). If the era were Śaka, the date would be ≈ 1850 CE. The weekday (Tuesday) has not been checked against either option. 'śrīmatkāmeśvarī bhakto kāmeśvarasya sevakaḥ' most likely describes the scribe as a devotee of the goddess Kāmeśvarī and her consort, the god Kāmeśvara, not as the servant of a man named Kāmeśvara. The words before the scribe's name ('lalitā…tmena') are damaged. They could be 'lalitātmajena' ('son of Lalitā[...]'), which would name a parent, but they are too uncertain to record as a person.
